previous_statement: Combining nodes 1.5.1 and 1.5.2 yields ||Ax||_inf>=(1-3*epsilon)||x||_inf for every x. Substituting epsilon=K*eta in this estimate and in node 1.4 gives exactly the three bounds in node 1; node 1.3 supplies commutativity, k, and iota, so the root conclusion follows.
new_statement: For every x in l_inf^k, node 1.5.2 implies ||Ax||_inf >= ||Delta iota x|| - 2*epsilon*||x||_inf, while node 1.5.1 gives ||Delta iota x|| >= (1-epsilon)*||x||_inf. Hence ||Ax||_inf >= (1-3*epsilon)*||x||_inf.
